record.reason: This is an empirical study of how Chain-of-Thought demonstration length affects reasoning accuracy; it finds task-dependent effects but does not propose an inference optimization. Shorter demonstrations could affect token cost, but net serving benefit is unmeasured.
record.title: The Impact of Reasoning Step Length on Large Language Models
